def run(session, query, top_k):
    # Retrieve ids from different search modes over the whole query
    ids_dense = session.search(query, top_k=top_k, mode='dense').ids()
    ids_keyword = session.search(query, top_k=top_k, mode='keyword').ids()
    ids_hybrid = session.search(query, top_k=top_k, mode='hybrid').ids()
    ids_hyde = session.hyde_search(query, top_k=top_k).ids()

    # Fuse all retrieved ids
    fused_ids = fuse_ids([ids_dense, ids_keyword, ids_hybrid, ids_hyde])

    # Rerank the fused ids and return top_k
    reranked_ids = rerank(session, query, fused_ids, top_k=top_k)

    return reranked_ids
